facts.fact: The Government of Lesotho (MICSTI) held a second draft of the Broadband and Shared Infrastructure Policy and Implementation Plan, with a monitoring and evaluation framework, dated by the proxy publish date of 17 February 2025; the document states no plan period and says formal broadband legislation is lacking.
